enchantment.abyssalcraft.coralium.desc.en: Inflicts the Coralium Plague on hit

enchantment.abyssalcraft.dread.desc.en: Inflicts the Dread Plague on hit

enchantment.abyssalcraft.iron_wall.desc.en: Reduces the amount of knockback applied when hit by an attack

enchantment.abyssalcraft.sapping.desc.en: Increases the amount of energy a Staff of Rending can drain

enchantment.abyssalcraft.multi_rend.desc.en: Drains energy from mobs surrounding the target

enchantment.cofhcore.holding.desc.en: Increases the storage capacity of certain items.

enchantment.cofhcore.insight.desc.en: Increases experience gain when using the item.

enchantment.cofhcore.leech.desc.en: Restores health when a mob is killed.

enchantment.cofhcore.multishot.desc.en: The bow will fire additional arrows with each shot. Only one arrow is consumed.

enchantment.cofhcore.smashing.desc.en: Harvested ores will be smashed to pieces, improving yield.

enchantment.cofhcore.smelting.desc.en: Harvested blocks will automatically be smelted, as if by a Furnace.

enchantment.cofhcore.soulbound.desc.en: The item will remain with the owner after an untimely demise.

enchantment.cofhcore.vorpal.desc.en: Randomly performs powerful attacks and decapitations.

enchantment.draconicevolution.enchant_re.en: When applied to a weapon this enchant increases that chance that a mob killed by sad weapon will drop their soul. This enchantment is best applied to Draconic Evolution weapons as it stacks with their built in reaper modifier.

enchantment.evilcraft.unusing.desc.en: Tools become unusable when having one durability left

enchantment.evilcraft.vengeance.desc.en: Using a tool will spawn Vengeance Spirits

enchantment.openblocks.explosive.desc.en: Triggers explosions of varying size when jumping or taking damage.

enchantment.openblocks.last_stand.desc.en: Instead of dying when taking fatal damage, the player is left with 1 health at the cost of experience, costs based on damage and reduced by the total level of Last Stand on all equipment.

enchantment.openblocks.flim_flam.desc.en: Causes a number of negative effects to nearby players.

enchantment.spartanshields.ssenchspikes..en: Deals damage to enemies that hit the shield when blocking

enchantment.minecraft.fire_protection.de.en: Reduces the effects of fire damage. Also reduces the burn time when set on fire.

enchantment.minecraft.feather_falling.de.en: Reduces fall damage and ender pearl teleportation damage.

enchantment.minecraft.blast_protection.d.en: Reduces damage from explosions and explosion knockback.

enchantment.minecraft.projectile_protect.en: Reduces damage from projectiles such as arrows and fire balls.

enchantment.minecraft.respiration.desc.en: Extends the amount of time the player can spend under water. Also improves vision while under water.

enchantment.minecraft.thorns.desc.en: Causes damage to enemies when they attack you.

enchantment.minecraft.sharpness.desc.en: Increases the damage of the item.

enchantment.minecraft.smite.desc.en: Increases damage against undead mobs such as zombies and skeletons.

enchantment.minecraft.bane_of_arthropods.en: Increases damage against arthropods such as Spiders and Silverfish.

enchantment.minecraft.knockback.desc.en: Increases the knockback strength of the weapon.

enchantment.minecraft.fire_aspect.desc.en: Causes additional fire damage when used to attack a mob.

enchantment.minecraft.looting.desc.en: Mobs will drop more loot when killed.

enchantment.minecraft.efficiency.desc.en: Increases mining speed of the tool.

enchantment.minecraft.silk_touch.desc.en: Allows fragile blocks such as glass to be collected.

enchantment.minecraft.unbreaking.desc.en: Causes the tool to lose durability at a slower rate.

enchantment.minecraft.fortune.desc.en: Some blocks like coal and diamond ore may drop additional items.

enchantment.minecraft.power.desc.en: Increases the damage of arrows fired from the bow.

enchantment.minecraft.punch.desc.en: Increases the knockback strength of arrows fired by the bow.

enchantment.minecraft.flame.desc.en: Arrows fired from the bow will deal additional fire damage.

enchantment.minecraft.infinity.desc.en: Allows the bow to fire normal arrows for free. You must have at least one arrow for this to work.

enchantment.minecraft.luck_of_the_sea.de.en: Increases the chance of getting good loot while fishing.

enchantment.minecraft.lure.desc.en: Decreases the amount of time it takes for a fish to bite the hook.

enchantment.minecraft.depth_strider.desc.en: Increases movement speed while under water.

enchantment.minecraft.frost_walker.desc.en: Freezes water under the player into cracked ice.

enchantment.minecraft.mending.desc.en: Repairs the durability of armor and tools with EXP.

enchantment.minecraft.binding_curse.desc.en: Prevents the enchanted item from being removed from an armor slot.

enchantment.minecraft.vanishing_curse.de.en: Destroyes the enchanted item if you die with it in your inventory.

enchantment.minecraft.sweeping.desc.en: Increases the damage of sweeping attacks.
